[i][b]Here's the short changelog:

notes.title: The Cult: Marduk's Longest Night Walkthrough

We've just posted a bare-bones walkthrough to get through the game. It only covers what is necessary to complete the game but not all the optional interactions or how to get the achievements.

notes.title: Versione 1.0.3 released
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35603336/9ac92ff6247289eb524661401282c109289fb610.png[/img]
[i][b]
Hello fellow adventurers!
Welcome to Harvester City! Sadly you won't be sightseeing, you'll have to spend a very long night with Caleb Marduk. But don't worry, demons, psychopaths and morally questionable humans will keep you company!
We're proud to announce that Marduk's journey is finally available in Russian![/b][/i]

ENJOY


Here's the changelog: 
[list]
[*] Added Russian language

[*] General optimization

[*] English typos fixed

[*] Hint system issue in German version fixed

[*] Added Marduk's remarks

[*] Minor graphic fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 released!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35603336/38335aa85edaf46f194d5b1d5365c1e5eb11d290.png[/img]

Hello fellow adventurers!

We've just released a small patch fixing some minor issues and typos in German version. Regarding the keys' puzzle, now the hint system comes to your rescue faster than before. It's still up to you if you want to use it or not.

Here's the short changelog: 
[list]
[*] Fixed hotspot revealer's issue
[*] Fixed shaking scrolling during Blavatsky's cutscene
[*] Typos fixed 
[*] Hint system revised 
[/list]


If you have played The Cult: Marduk's Longest Night and enjoyed it, please consider writing a review.

Thank you for your support!
